# truenas_filesystem_acl (Data Source)

Reads the current ACL of a filesystem path via filesystem.getacl.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Absolute filesystem path to look up.

### Read-Only

- `acltype` (String) ACL type in effect: "NFS4" or "POSIX1E".
- `entries` (String) JSON array of Access Control Entries. See the resource schema for the exact shape.
- `gid` (Number) Numeric group ID of the path's group owner.
- `id` (String) Same as "path".
- `uid` (Number) Numeric user ID of the path's owner.
